claim.statement: Cognition documents Devin as a Brain plus Devbox architecture: the Brain remains in Cognition Cloud, while Enterprise Cloud runs each session's Devbox on an isolated Cognition-hosted machine and Customer Dedicated runs Devboxes in a customer-isolated single-tenant VPC connected through AWS PrivateLink or IPSec.

source.title: Enterprise Deployment
source.locator: Devin's Architecture; Enterprise Cloud Architecture; Customer Dedicated Deployment Architecture

limitations: This is publisher-described architecture, not an independently observed tenant, network or isolation receipt.
unknowns: The selected offering, region, tenant, Devbox image, Brain revision and effective network paths are unknown.
